title: Settle the Parakeet count: 627,057,310 vs 627,057,286
verdict: BOTH FIGURES ARE CORRECT ON DIFFERENT BASES. The 24-parameter delta is 24 scalar I64 BatchNorm step counters (`num_batches_tracked`), one per encoder layer.

ledger_recommendation.rationale: Rule 1.2 excludes 'I64 index/shape buffers and constant tensors that carry no learned value'. `num_batches_tracked` is a BatchNorm forward-pass counter -- an int64 scalar incremented once per training batch. It carries no learned value, is never read at inference, and is not a parameter under any reading of 1.2.
ledger_recommendation.note: 01_STACK_DECISION.md counts 627,057,310 as the 'conservative' figure. Retaining the conservative figure costs 24 parameters and changes no stack's compliance. Either is defensible; what matters is that the delta is now named and closed rather than open.

method: safetensors header parse via HTTP Range; sum of prod(shape) partitioned by dtype. Cross-checked against the .nemo container (TAR -> model_weights.ckpt -> ZIP central directory -> data.pkl meta-unpickle).

the_24.explanation: One scalar per encoder layer, 24 encoder layers, 24 scalars. These are torch BatchNorm `num_batches_tracked` buffers.
the_24.note: There are exactly 24 non-F32 tensors in the file and all 24 are this buffer. The residual is fully accounted -- nothing is unexplained.

per_module_decomposition.basis: safetensors, top-level module prefix, all tensor elements
per_module_decomposition.note: encoder = 24 x 25,191,425 + stem/pre-encode remainder. Per-layer encoder cost is 25,191,425.

byte_reconciliation.comment: Exact to the byte. This is what a tensor-level parse buys over a bytes/4 bound.

cross_check_nemo.method: TAR member walk -> model_weights.ckpt -> ZIP central directory -> data.pkl meta-unpickle (no weights read)
cross_check_nemo.interpretation: The encoder -- 97.1% of the model -- is bit-for-bit identical in count between the two packagings. The differences are entirely in the decoder/joint/projector head, which the HF-transformers repackaging restructures, plus a 33,296-element `preprocessor` block (mel filterbank + STFT window) that the .nemo carries as a module buffer and the safetensors export drops. The .nemo `preprocessor` is non-learned DSP constant data and would not count under 1.2 anyway.
cross_check_nemo.which_basis_ships: The safetensors export is the basis for the shipped artefact (sherpa-onnx / QNN exports derive from it). 627,057,286 / 627,057,310 stands.
cross_check_nemo.flag: The two packagings of the SAME checkpoint differ by 4,892,144 parameters in their head modules. Any future audit that mixes a .nemo-derived figure with a safetensors-derived figure for parakeet will be wrong by that amount. Recorded so it cannot be rediscovered as a surprise.

compliance_effect: NONE. 24 parameters against a 2,000,000,000 cap. H's headroom is 602,998,280; D's is 168,458,623.
